title: Release notes · AviQuiz
heading: Release notes
overview: What is new in AviQuiz, newest first. Production dates are recorded when a release is deployed; preview releases are not yet live in production.
alpha02Intro: This alpha expands seasonal practice across Colombia, adds Spanish, and brings optional account-based statistics to AviQuiz.
alpha02Languages: English and Colombian Spanish interfaces, with a language selector and localized labels, help, dialogs, and application messages.
alpha02Colombia: Colombia-wide seasonal species data, with country, department, and processed-site quizzes. Species need available photo references to enter a photo quiz; photo coverage is still expanding.
alpha02Photos: Photo selection prefers the quarters in your seasonal window: January–March, April–June, July–September, and October–December. Windows spanning quarters can use either; other photo dates are used when matching photos are unavailable.
alpha02Statistics: Optional signed-in statistics across devices, cumulative identification history and latest-result comparisons, browser-statistics consent, and import of older browser statistics. Guest quizzes remain available without an account.
alpha01Intro: The first public alpha brings visual and audio bird-identification practice to aviquiz.org.
alpha01Quizzes: Photo and audio quizzes with site and family filters, mistake review, and separate visual/audio progress.
alpha01Geography: North Carolina seasonal geography quizzes, alongside the original Colombia itinerary and practice material.
alpha01Accounts: Invitation-based accounts and guest quizzes open to everyone.
alpha02Workflow: A reusable command-line workflow for processing additional geographies, producing common seasonal data packages, and queuing photo metadata while reusing coverage already collected for other geographies.
